context: Tests whether the agent creates a complete, correctly wired AEM Forms custom component: folder/file naming, the _<name>.json definition and authoring model, decorate() wired to the form model via subscribe with listenChanges, registration in mappings.js and authoring filters, README contract, and an honest validation report, and a browser end-to-end test that renders the form from local form JSON.

checklist.name: Component folder layout
checklist.description: Files exist at `blocks/form/components/loan-slider/loan-slider.js`, `blocks/form/components/loan-slider/loan-slider.css` and `blocks/form/components/loan-slider/_loan-slider.json` (folder name, JS and CSS file names all identical to `loan-slider`)

checklist.name: fd:viewType matches name
checklist.description: `_loan-slider.json` has a definition whose `plugins.xwalk.page.template` contains `"fd:viewType": "loan-slider"` and `"fieldType": "number-input"`, with a `resourceType` under `core/fd/components/form/`

checklist.name: Authoring model with min/max/step
checklist.description: `_loan-slider.json` has a `models` entry with `id` `loan-slider` whose fields include number-type properties for minimum, maximum and step (e.g. `component: "number"`), each with `component` and `name`

checklist.name: Reuses shared fields
checklist.description: The model reuses shared field definitions through `"..."` references (e.g. `../../models/form-common/_basic-input-fields.json` or `_help-container.json`) whose relative paths resolve from the component folder, rather than redefining basic fields by hand

checklist.name: Registered in mappings.js
checklist.description: `blocks/form/mappings.js` includes `'loan-slider'` in the `customComponents` array (existing entries preserved)

checklist.name: Authoring filter / palette
checklist.description: `loan-slider` is added to the `"form"` filter `components` list in `blocks/form/_form.json` and/or the custom-components group of `models/_component-definition.json` references `../blocks/form/components/loan-slider/_loan-slider.json#/definitions`

checklist.name: Default export decorate
checklist.description: `loan-slider.js` has `export default function decorate(...)` (or async) taking the field element, field JSON, container and formId, and returns the field element

checklist.name: subscribe with listenChanges
checklist.description: `loan-slider.js` imports `subscribe` from `'../../rules/index.js'` and calls it with `{ listenChanges: true }`, handling the `'register'` event and the `'change'` event (reacting to `propertyName === 'value'` to update the slider)

checklist.name: User changes reach the model
checklist.description: Slider input updates the form model either by setting `fieldModel.value` or by dispatching `new Event('change', { bubbles: true })` on the underlying number input; it does not set the model value unconditionally inside its own value-change handler

checklist.name: Authored properties read
checklist.description: min/max/step are read from the field JSON `properties` object (e.g. `fieldJson.properties.min`) and applied to the range input

checklist.name: Component README
checklist.description: `blocks/form/components/loan-slider/README.md` exists with a title, an authoring-properties / how-to-use section, and a usage-notes section naming the base type and viewType

checklist.name: E2E test written
checklist.description: A Playwright end-to-end test exists for the component (e.g. `test/e2e/custom-components/loan-slider/loan-slider.spec.js` with a form JSON whose field has `":type": "loan-slider"`) that renders the form locally (form JSON in the form block's `<pre><code>`, no deployed URL) and asserts: the component loads, a model value set programmatically updates the slider/label, and moving the slider updates the model value

checklist.name: Honest validation report
checklist.description: `VALIDATION.md` lists concrete checks performed on the generated files (e.g. a structural validator, lint, build:json) with their results, explicitly states which checks could not be run in this environment instead of claiming they passed, and gives browser verification steps (open a form using the component and confirm it loads/syncs with the model)
